judged_text: Team admin authorization logic inverted: `isTeamAdminOrOwner` uses `&&` instead of `||`, requiring both admin AND owner status; since isTeamOwner is a strict subset of isTeamAdmin, this resolves to owner-only, causing team admins who aren't owners to get a 403 on a feature they should be able to use (addGuests.handler.ts:45-47)

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner to pass the authorization check. The variable name and typical permission intent imply admin OR owner should be sufficient; as written, a non-owner admin would fail `isTeamAdminOrOwner` and (if not organizer/attendee) hit the `FORBIDDEN` branch.
